disposition_reason: Original ICP-AES measurements of nine metals in liver, meat and gizzard of broilers reared on one Nigerian farm, with feed, water, droppings and soil as source samples.

study.design: Farm study: day-old chicks reared 8 weeks on one commercial poultry farm; organs, feed, water, droppings and soil analyzed
study.origin: commercial poultry farm, Abak LGA, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria; feed bought in Abak and Uyo LGAs
study.method: ICP-AES after HNO3/HCl digestion of samples oven-dried at 60 °C for 72 h
study.qa: DORM-2 dogfish muscle CRM, recoveries 91-108%, R2 0.87-0.98

findings.group: commercial poultry farm, Abak, Akwa Ibom State (birds reared for the study)
